messages.content:
You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule: Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says 'remote.'

REJECT if: requires living in US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan. Requires local work authorization outside Taiwan. Is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only. Requires fixed working hours forcing Jerry to work midnight-6am Taiwan time.

KEEP only if: worldwide remote OR work from anywhere OR global remote OR APAC remote OR international contractors allowed OR accepts people anywhere OR uses EOR/Deel/Remote.com/Oyster/contractor agreement.

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown:
{"taiwan_eligible":"yes/no/unclear","reason":"short reason under 20 words","location_risk":"low/medium/high","timezone_risk":"low/medium/high","contractor_possible":"yes/no/unclear","decision":"keep/reject/manual_check"}

Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Background:
- Bilingual: English and Mandarin
- Grew up in California and Taiwan
- Digital marketing background
- Data science bootcamp experience
- Skills: Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- Experience: Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Projects: Dashboards, EDA, machine learning, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics

Make the letter specific to the job. Mention how Jerry can help:
- Reduce manual analysis time
- Improve reporting speed
- Connect marketing and data
- Build AI-assisted workflows
- Turn messy data into business action

Keep it under 220 words. Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate. Return only the cover letter text.

={{ 'Write a cover letter for this job:

Job Title: ' + $json.job_title + '
Company: ' + $json.company + '
Location: ' + $json.location_text + '
Salary: ' + ($json.salary || 'not listed') + '

Job Description (excerpt):
' + ($json.description || '').substring(0, 1000) }}

' + $json.job_url }}
